title: Arachnid
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Alice (Arisu), a high school girl bullied at school and abused at home by her uncle, sees her uncle killed by an assassin called Arachnid (Kumo). Instead of being killed, she is taken in as his apprentice and drawn into a world of insect-themed assassins who fight to the death. English release on Manga Up! Global.
life_message: Survival belongs to whoever is willing to fight and kill for it.
